test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_dictionary_filter.parquet', Parquet) SELECT multiIf( number % 64 = 0, '', number % 64 = 1, 'zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz', number % 10000000 < 1000, 'rare_model', concat('model_', toString(number % 512))) AS model, toUInt32(number % 1000) AS region FROM numbers(300000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 1000000, output_format_parquet_write_bloom_filter = 0, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1, max_block_size = 1000000, max_insert_block_size = 1000000
test.query: SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_filter.parquet', Parquet) WHERE model = 'rare_model' SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_filter.parquet', Parquet) WHERE model = 'absent_model' SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_filter.parquet', Parquet) WHERE model IN ('rare_model', 'absent_model') SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(region) FROM file('test_parquet_dictionary_filter.parquet', Parquet) WHERE model = 'rare_model' SETTINGS max_threads = 1 FORMAT Null
